title: The Old Woman and the Physician
summary: An elderly woman promised a physician a large fee if he cured her blindness. Every time the doctor visited and applied ointment, he stole a piece of her furniture....
keywords: the old woman and the physician
full_text:
An elderly woman promised a physician a large fee if he cured her blindness. Every time the doctor visited and applied ointment, he stole a piece of her furniture.

When her sight was restored, she refused to pay.

Before the judge, she stated: "When I was blind, I could see all my furniture in my house; now that he has 'cured' me, I see none of it, so I am blinder than before!"
moral: A rogue who robs his patient cannot claim his fee.
